acceptanceCriteria: With >=100k corpus records, a 100-path docs_locate batch returns in under 1 s p95 and each receipt equals the single-path call.
A call past the per-call deadline returns a structured deadline-exceeded (a batch names its unresolved paths) and the server keeps serving.
Every corpus MCP result reports load, verify, freshness, query, total and CPU milliseconds in _meta corvint/timing.
initialize + tools/list finish in under 1 s with no rederivation at startup; the first call reports its load cost.
Spec DCP-V1-143..145 and traceability updated in the same change.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1236: docs_locate with a 62-path batch on a ~101k-record corpus never answered (~40 CPU-min, 1.7 GB). #1237: corpus MCP startup took ~9 s and ~1.6 GB because it rederived the artifact before tools/list. Fix: lazy load with digest+pin re-verified memo, live freshness reused per repository observation, cited-only symbol re-resolution, paths batch, per-call deadline and timing meta. Sources: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1236 https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1237
title: GH #1236/#1237: corpus MCP docs_locate batches never answer and startup rederives the artifact (9 s, 1.6 GB)
